J_GPDH=kGPDH*sqrt(FBP/1uM). J_PDH=(p1/(p2+NADHm/NADm))*(Cam/(p3+Cam))*J_GPDH, NADm=NADtot-NADHm [Ca-activated dehydrogenase flux, NADH product-inhibited].
